author: Rhianna Schmunk
description: Canada's foreign affairs minister says the decision to let Russia back into the ice hockey world championships came as a "great disappointment" on Friday, as the country's ongoing invasion of Ukraine stretches toward its fifth year.
title: Decision clearing path for Russia to join world juniors in Alberta is 'very unwelcome,' minister says

author: Valérie Ouellet, Michelle Allan
description: The Canadian Crime Stoppers Association is advising its local chapters to solely accept tips by telephone instead of online, it said in a statement to CBC News on Friday.
title: Canadian Crime Stoppers Association advises chapters to accept tips by phone only

author: Thomas Daigle
description: The U.S. Department of Justice says charges have been laid against five more Canadians for voting fraud-related offences, the latest in a flurry of similar prosecutions ahead of next week's midterm elections.
title: U.S. charges 5 more Canadians with voter fraud offences amid Trump administration crackdown

author: David Thurton
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney says Ottawa made progress on a trade irritant with the European Union — a pending carbon tariff on energy intensive Canadian goods.
title: Canada finding 'solutions' on EU carbon tariff threat: Carney

author: Alex Boyd
description: In an email, the party's executive director said Rath had "made clear" he did "not support" the party.
title: Alberta separatist Jeff Rath kicked out of governing United Conservative Party

author: Isaac Olson
description: As accusations of misconduct against Montreal’s police service mount, Chief Fady Dagher says he is taking concrete steps to bring change from the ground up while investigating and potentially prosecuting those "one per cent" of officers who "tarnish the uniform."
title: Montreal police chief defends push to change force's culture, weed out bad apples

description: The federal government has listed Roberts Bank Terminal 2 in Delta, B.C., as a "project of national interest" to expand and diversify Canada's trade capacity.
title: Feds tap Delta, B.C., port expansion as 'project of national interest'

author: Gabriela Silva Ponte
description: Some Backstreet Boys fans attending one of the group’s Toronto shows aren’t happy with their seat change after Live Nation relocated fans who unknowingly bought tickets that had an obstructed view.
title: Some Backstreet Boys fans consider refund after Live Nation relocates them to cheaper, still-obstructed seats

description: Fans gather in Milwaukee on Friday for the Brewers' championship parade and celebration after the Major League Baseball team won its first World Series in the franchise's 57-year history.
title: IN PHOTOS | Brewers' championship rally

description: The tech-heavy Nasdaq shed about 3 per cent by mid afternoon. In Canada, the S&P/TSX composite index was down about 2.3 per cent. Worries are rising about whether the hundreds of billions of dollars invested in AI will produce enough profit and productivity to make the investment worth it.
title: Tech sell-off deepens, sending Wall Street toward its worst day since June

author: Cameron Kilfoy
description: In an incident captured on video, a piece of the landing gear on a PAL Airlines plane came off during landing on Friday in Wabush.
title: WATCH: PAL Airlines flight loses wheel after landing in Wabush, N.L.

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: The second Dune movie's merchandise, widely deemed to be NSFW, is making a comeback ahead of Dune: Part Three. And movie theatre chains didn't dial it back. They've doubled down.
title: Dune 3 popcorn buckets are even more unhinged than the original

author: Erika Morris
description: Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk said he was overwhelmed with emotion looking at the Earth during a seven-hour spacewalk on Thursday.
title: A spacewalk to remember: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk says seeing Earth 'changed' him

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: From pop icons and movie legends to unexpected throwbacks, celebrities are going all out for this Halloween. Here's a roundup of costumes turning the internet into one big Halloween party.
title: IN PHOTOS | Celebrity Halloween costumes to inspire your spooky season

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Ian McKellen has shared a tribute to his lifelong friend Patrick Stewart in the wake of his death, describing him as true to Yorkshire upbringing and "a man to rely on, to admire and in my case, love."
title: Ian McKellen calls lifelong friend Patrick Stewart the 'most respected and beloved actor,' in moving tribute

author: Sarah Smellie
description: Newfoundland and Labrador's premier says an agreement with Quebec to develop energy in Labrador is not open for renegotiation.
title: Churchill River energy agreement with Quebec not open for renegotiation, says N.L.

author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours
description: Human rights advocates are renewing their calls for Canada to put forward "binding laws" and set up an independent mechanism to investigate possible abuses linked to the activities of Canadian companies outside the country.
title: Canada faces fresh scrutiny, calls to do more to prevent Canadian corporate abuses abroad

author: John Mazerolle
description: Patrick Stewart had dozens of credits on the screen and the stage, but for many people he will always be Capt. Jean-Luc Picard of the U.S.S. Enterprise NCC-1701-D. Here are five of Stewart's best Picard performances to seek out.
title: 5 unforgettable Patrick Stewart performances as Jean-Luc Picard

author: Mark Gollom
description: Convicted murderer Christa Pike says while she continues to get stronger, she has been in pain since surviving a botched execution in Tennessee last month.
title: Christa Pike says she's in 'constant pain' since surviving execution attempt

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: Candy prices have climbed steadily over the past six years, according to Statistics Canada inflation numbers. But some treats are trickier than others. We break down which candies got more expensive this Halloween.
title: Yes, Halloween candy is expensive this year — but some sweets are scarier than others

description: According to Radio-Canada, a Montreal police officer at Station 39 allegedly deleted video evidence provided in 2025 by a woman who was a victim of domestic violence.
title: Quebec launches investigation after Montreal police officer allegedly deleted domestic violence video from evidence

description: Statistics Canada GDP data for August shows economic growth was essentially flat in August despite a rebound in retail trade that more than offset a decline in July. Wholesale trade, meanwhile, fell 1.4 per cent in August, as most subsectors contracted.
title: Canadian economy stalled in August, points to September decline: StatsCan
Schools, officials prepare families for morning darkness after B.C. ditches fall time change

description: Starving residents of a Russian-held town in southern Ukraine began evacuating on Friday as part of a joint relief operation by the opposing sides, the first of its kind in more than four years of war.
title: Aid operation, evacuations underway in Ukraine's stricken city of Oleshky

description: A U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm says a North Korean unit was likely behind the hack that impacted more than $6 billion US on Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange.
title: Binance says $6.3B US hacked in what could be largest cryptocurrency theft ever

description: Russia teams must be allowed to play International Ice Hockey Federation events such as the world championships, the Court of Arbitration for Sport ruled on Friday.
title: Russia is back in the hockey world championships after sports court ruling

author: Alanna Kelly
description: The Squamish Nation will honour the whale's life and spirit through a ceremony and traditional practices.
title: Dead humpback whale that was struck by ferry towed to First Nation for ceremony

author: Wayne Thibodeau, Devon Goodsell
description: A year before the charges against Todd Joseph Irving in connection with the 1988 death of Byron Carr were withdrawn, details of the police investigation — including how hundreds of DNA samples were obtained, some without consent — were heard in a Charlottetown courtroom.
title: Police collected hundreds of DNA samples, some without consent, in search for Byron Carr’s killer

author: Sam Farley
description: A lawsuit against major producers of frozen potato products, including two industry giants from New Brunswick, can go ahead, a U.S. judge has ruled.
title: Potato price-fixing lawsuit alleging N.B. giants are part of 'good ol' boys network' goes ahead

author: Jackson Weaver
description: Apple TV's Nocturne has just enough serviceable storytelling and professionally lit scenes to lull you into habit-viewing. But after several episodes of uninspired reveals you might suddenly come to your senses and ask: "Wait, why am I watching this?"
title: Apple TV's Nocturne is Nordic noir by the numbers

author: Katie Simpson
description: A U.S. food distributor is suing the Trump administration over 50 per cent tariffs on Canadian goods, arguing the levies are illegal and threaten its business and Canadian suppliers.
title: Facing a potential $40M US tariff bill, this American importer is suing Trump to end some tariffs on Canada

author: Philip Drost
description: If you buy a box of candy in August, it's going to be tough to resist the temptation until October. Analysts credit this to clever packaging and marketing, along with the big boxes of candy showing up earlier and earlier each year.
title: Has your Halloween candy vanished? You may have fallen for the trick of the treat

author: Jackie McKay
description: Deb Haaland is running for governor of New Mexico, while Mary Peltola, Peggy Flanagan and N'kiyla (Jasmine) Thomas are running for seats in the U.S. Senate. No Indigenous woman has ever been elected to either role.
title: Indigenous women could make history in upcoming U.S. midterm elections

author: Willy Lowry
description: When Americans head to the ballot box, it is usually domestic issues that are at the front of mind, not foreign policy. But this time, Americans are linking the high price of gas and diesel with the U.S. war in the Middle East.
title: Why the war in Iran might cost Trump and the Republicans at the ballot box
